d: A tragic accident in Rajasthan has claimed the lives of eight labourers who were working on a road construction project after coming into contact with a high-voltage electricity line. The incident has sparked outrage and raised serious questions about safety arrangements at construction sites. Following the tragedy, local villagers staged a protest, demanding accountability and action from the authorities.
